The Varillian was a high elven ship used to transport elven children out of Quel'Thalas to the Wildhammer dwarves of the Hinterlands during the Third War when the Scourge invaded the elven land, alongside the Fellovar and the Morn'danel. The boat was quickly attacked by gargoyles who outnumbered and outmatched the few defenders. The priest Galell tried healing them, but it wasn't enough. The gargoyles damaged the ship, sending it underwater.

Varithoman the Penitent is the faithful chronicler of the Jailer. They were once a mortal soul who were condemned to the darkest parts of the Maw and, in their own words, "learned humility through [their] suffering". After the four giants Bahmethra, Hrestimorak, Nilganihmaht, and Salaranga launched a failed uprising against the Jailer and were punished for it, the master of the Maw asked Varithoman to make a record of the giants' crimes and the price they'd paid, as a reminder to others that it is folly to defy the Banished One.

Veins and deposits are protrusions of minerals (gems, ore, and stone) found around Azeroth and Outland, in caves and almost always in mines that can mined if you have the Mining profession and a mining pick. "Node" was another word for veins and deposits during the Wrath of the Lich King beta, but was later changed.

Vekniss Hatchlings are silithid workers found in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj who spawn during Fankriss the Unyielding encounter.

Vazario Linkgrease is a goblin engineering trainer located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions and was seen throwing dynamites.
Veil of Eclipse is a caster cloak. It was, at its introduction, the only cloak that had spell penetration on it.
The Veiled Blade was a mercenary group encountered in the Dungeon Set 2 questline. Horde characters start their Dungeon Set 2 quest chain at Mokvar, while Alliance can start it at Deliana.
Vejrek is a level 11 ice troll found near Frostmane Hold in Dun Morogh. Muren Stormpike wants Vejrek's head.
Vekniss Soldier are elite silithid workers found in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Killing them rewards 20 reputation with Brood of Nozdormu.

The Vault of Lights is a section of the Exodar that has a number of trainers, and is the favorite haunt of the Prophet Velen. A holographic museum of several Burning Legion minions takes up most of the Vault. Seemingly, the draenei want to have the upper hand if the Legion shows up again. Tour groups regularly view the displays, striding from one hologram to another. As they approach various hologram emitters, the emitters state facts about the particular unit, namely the name, the species, its affiliation, and its function. This area houses the Vindicators' Sanctum (paladin trainers), the Hall of the Mystics (mage/portal trainers and wand/reagent vendors), and the Anchorites' Sanctum (pries

Vasilii is crypt fiend of the Scourge. Vasilii, like all crypt fiends, is a gruesome creature with a spider-life face, a humanoid torso, and an arachnid abdomen. His form is bound with complex layers of bandages and wrappings. He knows the languages Common and Orcish.

Veil Shienor is a colony of Skettis, capital of the arakkoa. It is located in northeastern Terokkar Forest, east of the road between Terokkar and Hellfire Peninsula. One of the "Eyes of Skettis" is located here.
__NOTOC__ Velan Brightoak is a blood elf quest giver located at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
__NOTOC__ Velendris Whitemorn is a blood elf quest giver located in the fortified camp east of Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods.
Veil Reskk is a former draenei shrine that has been taken over by arakkoa and made into a settlement. It is located in northern Terokkar Forest.

Veil Lithic is a colony of Skettis, the capital of the arakkoa. It is located southwest of the Sha'tari Base Camp in the Bone Wastes, along the border between the Wastes and Terokkar Forest. The colony is presumably named after Lithic, Terokk's daughter. It is here that Terokk's minions have been corrupting the avians of Terokkar for their use.

Veil Shalas is the strongest of the arakkoa colonies in Terokkar Forest, located at the base of Skettis itself. It is here that Terokk's sages conduct their war against the Light. To find Veil Shalas, look along the eastern edge of the Bone Wastes.
Veiled Tanzanite is an gem that fits a red or yellow socket.

Vashj's Vial Remnant is a quest item required for attunement to the Battle for Mount Hyjal wing in the Caverns of Time. It is said that Illidan Stormrage took seven vials of water from the Well of Eternity before its destruction. Three were poured into the lake at the top of Mount Hyjal, but the other four were believed to have been lost. It was revealed that Illidan gave one each to his two top lieutenants, Kael'thas Sunstrider and Lady Vashj. This item is required for the following quest: *The Vials of Eternity
__NOTOC__ Velaada is a draenei quest giver located at Wildwind Peak in Azuremyst Isle. She is one of Nobundo's most accomplished pupils.

Vaxar is an ogre barbarian. She is one of the commanders of the Duskbelch tribe, and considered a hero to them. She is a bit intimidating and has a ruthless command.

The Vault of the Ravenian is located deep within Scholomance. It is accessed from the Headmaster's Study via the southern doorway on the lower level. This is where the wight the Ravenian can be found, amid a few skeletons.

Vazruden's War-Horn is located in Hellfire Ramparts. It's used to call back the last boss if a wipe occurs.
Veehja is a naga priestess being held captive by the Kvaldir in the Shrine of Scales in the Borean Tundra.

Vekgar is a wolvar quest giver found at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

Vault of Archavon is a raid dungeon found in Wintergrasp Fortress. Players may only enter the dungeon while their faction controls Wintergrasp. Notably, up to the release of Warlords of Draenor, all bosses in this instance granted honorable kills. 10 minutes before the battle for Wintergrasp starts, any boss who is not currently in combat turns to stone and cannot be fought again until after the battle is over.

Veil Sethekk is the first room encountered in Sethekk Halls. At one time this room had four exits, however, the north exit has caved in. Further past the veil Darkweaver Syth resides, having bent the elements to his will.
The Veiled Flawless Ametrine was created with Jewelcrafting but never made available.

As with normal (10-man), heroic (25-man) loot consists of a random selection of four Tier 7 (25) or Deadly Gladiator's Season 5 items; hand, leg or chest. Additionally, he has a chance to drop .
Vehicular Gnomeslaughter is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing 100 players in Wintergrasp using a vehicle or a cannon.

Vekniss is one of the major silithid hives that makes up the majority of the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. This hive is the largest known hive to exist, which due to being behind the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj has allowed it to grow without any outside interfere for thousands of years. Many of the bosses within the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj raid are members of this hive.

__NOTOC__ Velanaa is an Alliance holy paladin and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance. She is the carbon copy of Liandra Suncaller, who is faced by players on the Alliance.

Vek'nag is an orc quest giver in Durotar. He paces next to Margoz's camp. He works for Spiketooth the slavedriver, and is looking for help and supplies to fix their broken cart.

Vegard the Unforgiven appears in The Sacred and the Corrupt during the Shadowmourne questline to pick up Light's Vengeance. He attempts to deter adventurers from recovering Light's Vengeance, only for the mace to smash him to pieces. However, his skeleton rises in a last gambit, only to be permanently put down.
Vear Darksnout is a furbolg located at Thistlefur Hold in Ashenvale.
Varzok is a Battle Pet Trainer located on the central mesa in Orgrimmar. He provides training for Battle Pets for .

Vasuuvata is a draenei located at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands. She seems to serve no purpose. Strangely for a draenei, she is associated with the Darnassus faction, rather than the Exodar faction. Her voice lines are also that of a vendor, indicating she may have been planned to be a vendor at some point during Cataclysm development.
Vashj'elan Warriors are naga located in the Ruins of Vashj'elan in The Lost Isles.

in its Vault.]] The Vault of Y'Shaarj is an area under the Vale of Eternal Blossoms where the Heart of Y'Shaarj was sealed by the titans. Norushen was found here as keeper of prison of Y'Shaarj. During an excavation, goblins blasted their way into the vault. Their chief, Crafty the Ambitious was corrupted by the heart and was killed by adventurers. The heart was then claimed for the Horde by Malkorok. After N'Zoth was freed from its prison, the Vault of Y'Shaarj was used to contain a Font of Corruption and tended to by mantid loyal to the Black Empire.
Vault of Forbidden Treasures is a container found in the Vault of Y'Shaarj. This container can be accessed after defeating the Sha of Pride, it does not appear on Raid Finder or Flexible difficulty.

The Vault of the Earth is a vault located in southeastern Tanaan Jungle, between Zorammarsh, , Thundertail Wallow and Fang'rila. It is inhabited by the Guardians of the Vault, an order of orc shaman who, along with a group of furies, are guarding the :Cipher of Damnation behind a wall of fire. Following 's attack on the Vault and retrieval of the Cipher, most of the shaman were severely injured, and Lagar the Wise was killed.

The Vault of the Wardens was the Warden maximum security facility to hold all of the greatest threats to the world, including the body of Illidan Stormrage, his Illidari demon hunters, and other terrifying monsters. Being posted there was once considered prestigious.
Varyx the Damned is an arakkoa located at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.
Veetra the Tender is an orc food vendor located at the Vault of the Earth in Tanaan Jungle.

The Veiled Hand was a human sect who served the Burning Legion. The cult was formed during the Legion's third invasion. Its members were the ruling council of the Darkshire town and its guards, the Night Watch. Their goal was to bring about the downfall of Stormwind.
Vaultwarden Umbra is a jailer appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore, summoned by . He is later the target of the Uncrowned in Suramar where he serves Detheroc.
Vel'dromas is a nathrezim that appears at Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh, corrupting the local Frostmane tribe.
The Vault Guards are hobgoblins who can be found in the Uncrowned Vault in the Hall of Shadows.

Velen's Future Sight is sold by Arcanomancer Vridiel in Dalaran.

This world quest takes place inside the Vault of the Wardens 5-man dungeon. After defeating Glazer an owl statue off the battlefield glows green and offers a conversation option to begin the startup sequence. Activating this causes 9 owl statues to appear in a predefined pattern on the 5x5 board. Clicking a statue on the board causes the state of that cell and the 4 adjacent cells to toggle. An existing statue will sink into the board. An empty cell would have a statue rise up to occupy it. The goal is to have one statue remaining in the center. When that last statue is clicked the criteria for the world quest is satisfied. There are a number of 9-click solutions available. One of them is de
Veil Prowlers are large silver-grey owlcats that prowl about in eastern Azsuna, less than a mile west of the The Ruined Sanctum.
Vashti the Wandering Merchant is a night elf ghost vendor traveling the eastern path, from the Ruined Sanctum to Felblaze Ingress, in Azsuna.

__NOTOC__ The Vault of the Betrayer is the prison within which Illidan Stormrage's corpse was stored after he was killed at the Black Temple. It is located in the lowest recesses of the Vault of the Wardens.

There are two underwater demigods known as ancients in Vashj'ir. They have a lot of internal room inside of their shells, within which their brains and two hearts are exposed. Their well-being seems to be tied to the health of the surrounding reefs. It is unclear exactly how they're related to the Ancient Guardians, if at all.
Veiled Argunite is Argunite rewarded from quests, dropped by rare elites and looted from chests on Argus.
Vault Preservers are golems located in Primordial Observatory near the Maelstrom during the quest The Sunken Vault (quest).
Vault Sentinels are titanic watchers located in Primordial Observatory in the Maelstrom during The Sunken Vault (quest).
Vault Guardians are iron vrykul located in Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
Vasha the Red was a ghost of an orc blademaster located in . He was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Veiled Riftblades are void elves located throughout Telogrus Rift. They favor melee weaponry, and can usually be found with either a sword and shield, or large two-handed swords.
Vashera's Talisman drops from Blood Witch Vashera at Zalamar in Nazmir.
Veiled Cutthroats are located in Sagehold in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Veil Shadowrunners are unicorns located in Olivian Veil in Azsuna.
Veiled Wyrmtongue Chests are found all over the Broken Shore.
The Vault Guardian Core is a quest reward from The Blessing of the Watchers.
__NOTOC__ Vathikur is a serpent vignette that emerges from the ground in an enclosed area in southeastern Vol'dun after all of the Pit Snakes in the area have been killed.

The Vault of Kings is a room in the Great Seal in Dazar'alor. It is here that the Grand Challenger's Bounty is found. Examiner Alerinda works here, studying the artifacts of both the Zandalari Empire and their enemies.
__NOTOC__ Veiled Saboteurs are goblins, Forsaken, jungle trolls, and blood elves located in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
Veiled Deathstalkers are Forsaken located in the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale.
Vaza's Favorite Skull is located right behind Crazy Vaza in Zul'jan Ruins in Nazmir.
Vaza's Least Favorite Skull is located right behind Crazy Vaza in Zul'jan Ruins in Nazmir.
The Vault-Watcher's Breastplate drops from Ironaya in the Map Chamber in Uldaman.
Velen's Staff would be provided as an objective for Ending the Gloom.

__NOTOC__ The Vault of Law is the northern-most chamber on the second floor of the Vault of the Wardens. Immolanth was imprisoned within before the Burning Legion invaded the Vault, and now demon hunters are attempting to slay him.

The Vault of Silence is where demon hunters awake after being imprisoned by the Wardens upon their return to the Black Temple from Mardum. Many years have passed, and none other than Maiev Shadowsong rouses them from sleep in a last-ditch effort to drive back the Burning Legion that has invaded the remainder of the Vault of the Wardens.

The Veiled Cleft was a cave located above Wildpaw Ridge in Alterac Valley. It was here that Syndicate Master Ryson along with his fellow members of the Syndicate could be found. Due to an avalanche, the cave along with the ridge was blocked off from the rest of Alterac Valley.
The Veiled Hermit is a crab located on the expedition isles.

The Vault of the Archon is located at the Walk of Recollection in Bastion. The entrance is blocked by a forcefield and flanked by two Vault Guardians. The inner chamber fo the Vault of the Archon contains soul mirrors specific to the Paragons and the Archon herself.
__NOTOC__ Veil Blossoms are found at Ogre Ruins on Exile's Reach.
Source: [https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/Vector2D.lua SharedXML\Vector2D.lua]
Vasilica is a venthyr stable master located at the Absolution Crypt in Revendreth. She is also present in Sinfall.
Vaultkeeper Ta'khis is a broker located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos.
Vashj's Signal is provided by Baroness Vashj for Glorious Pursuits to summon two aranakk who capture Mephiles the Loyal.
Veilwing Sentries are veilwings located at Tirna Scithe and Kaithe Overlook in Ardenweald.
Veilwing Trainers are sylvar located at Tirna Scithe in Ardenweald.
Source: [https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/Vector3D.lua FrameXML/Vector3D.lua]
Veiled Augment Runes are looted from Veiled Satchel of Cooperation. This item is also a reward from a number of adventures.

The Vat of Conspicuous Slime is located at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. An Empty Plague Bottle can be found on the table beside it. The Empty Plague Bottle can be filled using the contents of the vat, creating a Phial of Ravenous Slime.
Veilwing's Heart drops from the Elusive Veilwing in Maldraxxus.
Vault Wardens are night elves located in the Vault of the Wardens.

Ve'nari's Refuge at the eastern end of Cocyrus is, straightforwardly enough, home to Ve'nari in the Maw. Players use this as their base of operations, and while in the area are not subject to the Eye of the Jailer.
Veiled Satchel of Cooperation is rewarded upon completing a random Shadowlands dungeon through Dungeon Finder while in a Call To Arms role.
Vault Zapper is found in the Forgotten Vault in Tiragarde Sound.
Vault Roaches are roaches located in the Vault of the Wardens.
Vassili Freeshot is a Maldraxxi skeleton located at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus.
Ve'nari's Portal is opened by Ve'nari in Perdition Hold in the Maw to allow travel back to Ve'nari's Refuge during Wake of Ashes (quest).

__NOTOC__ Ve'brax is a broker associated with Cartel Ve found in Desmotaeron in the Maw. He has been captured by the Mawsworn and claims to be next in line to be drained of anima by Runemaster Mavrok. After dispatching Mavrok, the players see Ve'brax in the middle of his escape, after he defeated two Mawsworn Runemasters, leaving a warning about Ve'nari.
